research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Nutanix is researching and developing systems for managing cloud and virtualization environments, as seen in titles like 'Common services model for multi-cloud platform' and 'Architecture for managing i/o and storage for a virtualization environment.' Abstracts describe unified namespace techniques for accessing unstructured data, high-availability database services, efficient data failover, and microservices deployment. These efforts focus on seamless app and data management across clouds, storage, and virtualized infrastructure.

about_short_description.short_description: Nutanix is a cloud software company that provides infrastructure and management platforms for private, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.

product.name: Nutanix Cloud Platform (NCP)
product.description: A unified platform for running virtual machines, containers, applications, and data across private, hybrid, and multicloud environments.

product.name: Nutanix Cloud Infrastructure (NCI)
product.description: A hyperconverged infrastructure platform that provides compute, storage, virtualization, networking, and lifecycle management for enterprise workloads.

product.name: Nutanix Cloud Manager (NCM)
product.description: A multicloud management suite for infrastructure operations, application self-service, automation, security governance, and cost control.

product.name: Nutanix Unified Storage (NUS)
product.description: A software-defined storage platform that provides file, object, and block storage from a common infrastructure and management layer.

product.name: Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2)
product.description: A hybrid-cloud service that extends the Nutanix operating model to public-cloud infrastructure for workload mobility and consistent operations.

product.name: Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP)
product.description: A Kubernetes management platform for deploying, securing, operating, and upgrading clusters and applications across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments.
